candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from selector to a different bytes4 constant (0x00000000).
Assign _baseToken to itself instead of the parameter, leaving baseToken uninitialized.
Remove the assignment `baseToken = _baseToken;` so baseToken keeps its default value (address(0)).
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;`, setting baseToken to the NFT address.
Remove the assignment `nft = _nft;` so nft remains the zero address after initialization.
Insert `nft = address(0);` after `nft = _nft;`, overwriting the stored nft address with zero.
Replace `changeFee = _changeFee;` with `changeFee = _changeFee + 1;`
Replace `changeFee = _changeFee;` with `changeFee = 0;`
Delete the statement `changeFee = _changeFee;`
Delete the assignment 'feeRate = _feeRate;' so the state variable retains its default value (0) after initialization.
Replace 'feeRate = _feeRate;' with 'feeRate = _feeRate + 1;' so the stored fee rate is one higher than the provided argument.
Replace 'feeRate = _feeRate;' with 'feeRate = uint16(0);' so the fee rate is always set to zero regardless of the argument.
Move the statement 'if (_feeRate > 5_000) revert FeeRateTooHigh();' after 'feeRate = _feeRate;' so the validation no longer guards against an out-of-range fee rate being stored.
Delete the assignment 'initialized = true;' so that the state variable remains false after initialize() completes.

Delete the 'if (initialized) revert AlreadyInitialized();' check, allowing multiple initializations where the second call would succeed and re-emit Initialize, keeping 'initialized' true (behavior difference: second call fails in original but succeeds in mutant).
Replace `payRoyalties = _payRoyalties;` with `payRoyalties = true;` so the state variable is always set to true regardless of the input parameter.
Replace `payRoyalties = _payRoyalties;` with `payRoyalties = false;` so the state variable is always set to false regardless of the input parameter.
Delete the statement `payRoyalties = _payRoyalties;` so `payRoyalties` retains its default false value regardless of the input parameter.
Replace `payRoyalties = _payRoyalties;` with `payRoyalties = !_payRoyalties;` so the state variable is set to the logical negation of the input parameter.
Replace 'useStolenNftOracle = _useStolenNftOracle;' with 'useStolenNftOracle = true;' so that the flag is always set to true regardless of the parameter.
Delete the assignment 'useStolenNftOracle = _useStolenNftOracle;' so the variable keeps its default value (false).
Move 'useStolenNftOracle = _useStolenNftOracle;' after 'initialized = true;' so the emit captures the new value but the state is written after the initialized flag.
Replace assignment to virtualBaseTokenReserves with a different constant value to change the observed state after initialize
Replace assignment to virtualBaseTokenReserves with _virtualNftReserves parameter, changing the stored base token reserve to the NFT reserve value
Delete the assignment to virtualBaseTokenReserves so it retains its default zero value instead of the parameter value
Delete the assignment of virtualNftReserves = _virtualNftReserves so it retains its default zero value.
